scope: Maintained native CLI, native schedule projection and explicit runtime major-version admission. Not full specification v3 parity.
limitations: Advanced review/grant/transfer operations still use the explicit command API or existing tools/UI.
Schedule next times are clock previews, not local admission receipts.
Shared occurrence history contains published receipts, not all local pending/running work.
Existing task-pane processes must be reopened to load the changed adapter.
Major-version admission is not certification of every future OpenCode 2.x API.
